about.title: The bot that runs your Telegram channel for you
about.lead: Connect a channel, pick your sources — RSS feeds, Reddit, news sites — and set a schedule. From there, the bot works on its own: finds fresh content, translates it into the right language, rewrites it in a lively style, generates an image if there isn't one, and publishes the post on time.
about.forWhomText: Owners of news, niche, and personal channels who want to keep their audience informed — without spending hours every day. Any topic: tech, finance, sports, culture, science.

features.f1: Any sources: RSS, Reddit, news feeds
features.f2: Auto-parsing every 30 minutes — fresh news first
features.f4: Image generation if the post has no picture
features.f5: Flexible schedule: from once an hour to once a day
features.f6: Up to 10 channels and 100 posts per day on the top plan
features.f7: Choose your AI model and custom prompt — for your tasks and style
features.f8: Pre-moderation: approve, reject, or edit before publishing
features.f9: Duplicate check — the same item won't be posted twice
features.f10: Channel and post stats right inside the mini app
